{{Quote|You summoned me, Chancellor?"<br />"Prepare my ship.|Mas Amedda and Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="The Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>}}
An '''''Eta''-class shuttle''' was a used by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] '''Darth Sidious''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The shuttle was not painted in the the red and white color scheme commonly seen in use by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], but was instead colored a nondescript gray color.

==Description==
[[File:SidiousApproachesMandalore-TL.png|thumb|left|220px|Darth Sidious' ''Eta''-class shuttle approaches Mandalore]]
An [[Eta-class shuttle/Legends|''Eta''-class shuttle]], the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was a drab, nondescript grey [[Color/Legends|color]]. It was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that allowed the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to make [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps.<ref name="S5Exclusive" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] learned that his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] were on Mandalore, so he used this shuttle to travel to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="S5Exclusive" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The shuttle landed at the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|docks]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]' [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], where Sidious disembarked and promptly [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|choked]] a pair of Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who attempted to stop him using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He then proceeded from his ship into the city, leaving the shuttle at the docks.<ref name="S5Exclusive" />
